scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with headline, subheadline, and call-to-action buttons for new visitors (REQ-1, US-1)

steps.description: Access the root URL of the application
steps.context: User is not authenticated, visiting for the first time

steps.description: Check that a prominent headline is displayed communicating the core value proposition
steps.context: Headline should be visible above the fold

steps.description: Check that a supporting subheadline explains the benefit of the URL shortening service
steps.context: Subheadline should complement the main headline

steps.description: Check that a primary CTA button exists with text like 'Get Started Free' or 'Create Account'
steps.context: CTA should be prominently styled and clearly visible

steps.description: Check that a secondary CTA link exists for returning users (e.g., 'Sign In')
steps.context: Secondary CTA should be less prominent than primary

test_cases.expected: Component renders without errors

test_cases.input: Check for headline element with text content
test_cases.expected: H1 element exists with headline text about URL shortening
Subheadline text element exists explaining the service benefits

test_cases.input: Check for primary CTA button with 'Get Started' or similar text
test_cases.expected: Button element exists with appropriate call-to-action text
Navigation to /register route is triggered
Link element exists for existing users to sign in
Navigation to /login route is triggered

test_cases.input: Verify hero section uses FuturisticButton component
test_cases.expected: CTA buttons use the existing FuturisticButton styling

scenarios.name: Navigation and Routing
scenarios.description: Verify the navigation bar provides access to Login and Register pages with proper routing (REQ-3, US-2, US-3)

steps.description: Access the root URL of the application
Check that the navigation bar is visible at the top of the page
Check that a clearly labeled 'Login' link is present in the navigation
steps.context: Login link should be easily findable

steps.description: Click on the Login link and verify navigation to /login
Check that a highlighted 'Register' or 'Sign Up' button exists
steps.context: Sign up should be more prominent than login

steps.description: Click on the Register button and verify navigation to /register
Check that clicking the logo returns to homepage
steps.context: Logo should link back to root URL

test_cases.expected: Navbar renders with all required navigation elements

test_cases.input: Check for Login link in navbar
test_cases.expected: Link element with text 'Login' or 'Sign In' exists
URL changes to /login

test_cases.input: Check for Register/Sign Up button in navbar
test_cases.expected: Button element with text 'Register' or 'Sign Up' exists
URL changes to /register
Logo or brand name element exists and is clickable
URL changes to / (homepage)

test_cases.input: Verify ThemeToggle is present in navbar
test_cases.expected: ThemeToggle component is rendered in the navbar

test_cases.input: Verify text readability at all viewports

test_cases.expected: Theme selection persists across navigation

Cyberpunk theme colors are applied correctly

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage meets accessibility requirements for keyboard navigation, screen readers, and visual accessibility (NFR-2)

steps.description: Use accessibility testing tools to audit the homepage
Tab through all interactive elements
steps.context: All buttons and links should be focusable

steps.description: Check that focused elements have visible focus indicators
Check text has sufficient contrast against backgrounds
steps.context: WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text

steps.description: Check that all images have appropriate alt attributes
Check for proper use of landmarks and ARIA attributes

test_cases.input: Tab through homepage from start to end
test_cases.expected: All interactive elements receive focus in logical order

test_cases.input: Check focus indicator visibility on buttons
test_cases.expected: Focus indicator is clearly visible on all buttons

test_cases.input: Check focus indicator visibility on links
test_cases.expected: Focus indicator is clearly visible on all links
Button activates and navigates correctly
Page has main, nav, and footer landmarks
All img elements have meaningful alt text or empty alt for decorative
One h1 exists, headings don't skip levels
All content is announced properly

Simulate slow network conditions

Clear localStorage and reload to verify defaults work

test_cases.expected: Homepage renders with default theme or shows appropriate fallback

test_cases.expected: Application shows 404 or redirects appropriately
Homepage renders with default theme settings
Component handles missing props gracefully with defaults

test_cases.input: Test FeaturesSection with empty features array
test_cases.expected: Component handles empty state appropriately

test_cases.input: Test Footer with missing links array
test_cases.expected: Footer handles missing props with defaults
